prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1303; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent the interests of our client in connection with a motor vehicle collision that occurred when the at-fault vehicle struck our client's vehicle while our client was turning left. Our client sustained injuries as a result of this incident and is currently receiving medical treatment.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, either by telephone or in writing. If your insured or any representative of your company needs to speak with our client, that contact must be arranged through this firm.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to your insured, along with a copy of the declarations page for the policy in force at the time of the collision.

Please also take immediate steps to preserve all evidence relating to this claim. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, vehicle event data recorder information, recorded statements, claim file materials, and any other documentation in your or your insured's possession. Failure to preserve such evidence may result in appropriate legal remedies being pursued.
